Oneliner

Track cargo shipping containers using a custom built deployable dish antenna.
Description

Track cargo shipping containers using a custom built deployable dish antenna (iTAG MATTS). Demonstrate electrical component radiation shielding techniques using tantalum foil. Proposing a "Stensat" beacon on UHF , a Microhard TX on UHF and a ItagMATTS downlink on 2425MHz.
